name: m-walk
js: (() => { const app = window.__CITY_APP, C = window.CITY; const r = C.nearestRoads(1785, -1868, 200)[0]; app.teleportTo(r.px, r.pz, Math.atan2(r.dx, r.dz)); app.cameraSystem.cinema = null; console.log("[walk] road " + r.road.name + " at " + r.px.toFixed(1) + "," + r.pz.toFixed(1) + " heading " + Math.atan2(r.dx, r.dz).toFixed(2)); })()

name: c-walk
js: (async () => { const a = window.__CITY_APP; let best = { triangles: 0 }; for (let k = 0; k < 12; k++) { await new Promise((r) => requestAnimationFrame(r)); const i = a.renderer.info; if ((i.render && i.render.triangles || 0) >= best.triangles) best = { triangles: i.render.triangles, calls: i.render.drawCalls }; } return { ...best, rafSamples: 12 }; })()

name: bytes
js: (() => { const e = performance.getEntriesByType("resource"); let t = 0, b = 0, d = 0; for (const x of e) { t += x.transferSize || 0; b += x.encodedBodySize || 0; d += x.decodedBodySize || 0; } return { requests: e.length, transferSize: t, encodedBodySize: b, decodedBodySize: d, names: e.map((x) => x.name.replace(location.origin, "").split("?")[0]).filter((v, i, a) => a.indexOf(v) === i).sort() }; })()
